description: Your restaurant is opening a new outdoor patio for the summer season. You must configure the Floreant POS Back Office to support the new section. First, create a new restaurant floor section named 'PATIO' and add six tables to it named 'P1', 'P2', 'P3', 'P4', 'P5', and 'P6'. Next, create a new tax rate called 'LIQUOR TAX' at 9.5%. Then create a new menu category called 'PATIO SPECIALS' and add five menu items to it: 'SANGRIA PITCHER' for $18.00, 'PALOMA COCKTAIL' for $11.00, 'DRAFT BEER PATIO' for $6.50, 'LOADED NACHOS' for $13.95, and 'GRILLED CORN' for $4.75. Back Office PIN is 1111. When the 'ENTER SECRET KEY' dialog appears, leave the field empty and click OK.
